'''Grig''', also called '''Grig City''', was one of the [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was served by [[Grig Starport]], located on [[Starport Street]], and was the location of the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]], [[Grig Employee Training School]], [[TGM Hospital]], and the [[The Free Access Grill|Free Access Grill]], all on [[Central Avenue]]. [[Stark Municipal Park]] was also located within the city limits.<ref name="Abduction" />
